title: 第八章 两名武者
content_zh:
“557分，本科线是561？”罗峰深吸一口气。
就差四分！就因为差这四分，自己就没有上军校的机会了。
十二年的文化教育学习，竟然是这样的结果。
“不能上军校，就不能上军校。又有什么大不了。”罗峰目光一凝，右手竖掌成刀直接朝前方一个横切，空气因为掌刀极速划过产生猛然颤动，发出了让人心颤的掌风声，“这次的昏迷，令我实力提高很多！”
“或许，我现在的身体素质，已经达到武者的身体素质。可以通过‘准武者考核’了。”
“就算差一点，相差也不大。认真努力苦练一两个月，就应该能通过‘准武者考核’。”
罗峰适应能力很强，这次的高考成绩没上本科线，这对他的打击很大，可是‘昏迷’导致他身体素质再一次提高，也令他心中有着自信！
毕竟，一名军校毕业生的地位，是远远不如一名武者的！
“咔！”罗峰
客厅里，父母罗洪国、龚心兰，以及弟弟罗华都转头看过来，三人眼中都有着关心。龚心兰更是站起来，连朝罗峰走来：“小峰，这次高考不能怪你，怪只怪你那个头疼病，唉，这病怎么这时候发作了，这都好几年没发作了。”
“哥，你不会被打击了吧？”弟弟罗华坐在轮椅上，故意打趣道。
之前罗峰在屋内查成绩，而父母和弟弟，也是通过弟弟‘罗华’的笔记本电脑，查到了高考成绩，知道罗峰的高考成绩竟然仅仅差四分就达到本科线。虽然他们有些失望，可是他们更担心罗峰。
罗峰一笑：“当然不会打击，爸妈，你们也别怪这头疼病，说实话，还要感谢这头疼病？”
“感谢？”
“感谢？”
“感谢？”
罗洪国、龚心兰，还有轮椅上的罗华都一个个愣住了，高考这可是人生这一辈子的大事，现在罗峰的高考被这头疼病给毁掉了，还感谢这头疼病？
“爸妈，阿华。”罗峰微微一笑道，“小时候我也有两次头疼到晕倒，实际上那两次醒来后，我都觉得力气增加不少，跑起来也更快。这一次……也是这样！我感觉得到，我的身体素质比过去强上一大截，估计能够通过‘准武者考核’。”
“什么？”罗洪国、龚心兰、罗华三人相互看了看。
“哥，真的假的？”罗华忍不住道。

“当然是真的。”罗峰微微一笑，“通过准武者考核后，就能申请‘武者实战考核’。我对自己实战能力很有自信，今年或许就能成为一名武者！”
父亲罗洪国，母亲龚心兰，弟弟罗华，三人都被这个消息给震住了。
武者啊！
那代表着什么？那代表着人类群体中地位最超然的一群人，代表着特权！代表着大量金钱！代表着高高在上的地位！而且一旦成为武者，带给家庭的各种好处，比成为军校的精英学员要好的多。
“我们家要出一名武者了？”弟弟罗华忍不住大叫起来，“哈哈，哥，我崇拜你。”
“小峰，好啊。”罗洪国也是兴奋的一拍罗峰肩膀，“成为武者好啊，和武者一比，军校毕业生又算什么？”
现如今，全世界人类社会，对于武者都是很崇拜很敬仰的。
见到爸妈、弟弟这么开心，罗峰呵呵一笑：“爸妈，不过还没经过考核，也不能得意太早的。”
“18周岁的武者？”罗华不由兴奋的嗷嗷直叫，“如果我哥真成了十八周岁的武者，那，那实在是太，太……牛了！！！”
××××××
第二天早晨五点，天蒙蒙亮。
罗峰就离开家，朝极限武馆赶去。
“这时候人还真少。”罗峰进入极限武馆后，就发现整个武馆的草地、路道上，只能看到大概近百人的身影。要知道整个武馆的学员有三四万之多的，“每次武馆老师教课，都是晚上教课，晚上才是武馆人最多的时候。”
行走在路道上，罗峰直接赶往高级学员教学楼。
“轰隆隆～～”低沉的气浪声传来。
“咦？”
罗峰不由转头看去，只见一辆通体白色的显得很是华丽的跑车，缓缓驶进了武馆当中，罗峰不由仔细一看，不由倒吸一口凉气：“是阿斯顿马丁的跑车？还是最新款最昂贵的带有飞行功能的thr―191？”
弟弟是非常喜欢跑车的，在家的时候，也和罗峰夸赞过这辆thr－191。
“是阿斯顿马丁啊。”
“是191呢，这可是带飞行功能的。”武馆院内，本三三两两稀少的学员们一个个被吸引过来，“这一辆车，要3600万华夏币呢。”

就在这时候，跑车停在了高级学员教学楼门口。车门染的，他的目光随意的朝周围一扫，掠过那些普通的武馆学员，在罗峰身上略作停顿，而后没说什么，就直接进入了教学楼。
“是武者。”罗峰眼睛一亮。
刚才这名武者的眼神，都让罗峰觉得压力，这是经历过一次次生死厮杀后，有着钢铁般意志的眼神。
“过去我在武馆从来没见过这名武者？他来武馆干什么？”罗峰也进入了高级学院教学楼的三楼练武厅。
宽敞的练武厅中，空荡荡，一个人也没有。
现在只是早上五点多，就算是人最多的晚上，这里一般也不超过二十人，更别说一大清早了。
“我要看看，现在我的实力，到底达到了多少。”罗峰走过去，将拳力测试机的插头给插上，开关
站在拳力测试机前。
“开始吧！”
罗峰深吸一口气，腰胯为中心，强劲的力道透过腰胯发出，而后脊椎猛然弓起，就仿佛一条大蟒蛇，产生一股强劲的力道透过手臂，节节贯串，而后罗峰的拳头就仿佛一道闪电，猛然‘蓬’的声就砸在拳靶上。
“滴，滴，滴！”拳力测试机发出连续三声。
罗峰眼睛一亮，平常拳力测试机是不会这种声音的，发出这种声音代表一种情况――拳力超过了1000kg。
“嗯？”罗峰盯着那拳力测试机的显示屏――‘1089kg’。
“这么多？”
罗峰心中一阵狂喜，武者的身体素质要求是拳力必须达到900kg，而之前自己的拳力是809kg，现在竟然达到了1089公斤，一下子增加了280公斤。远超合格线。
“哈哈。”
罗峰兴奋的双拳闪电般出拳，整个人左右晃动，只听得‘蓬’‘蓬’的声音不断，几乎眨眼功夫，罗峰就击打了二十多拳。而拳力测试机的屏幕上也显现了一连窜的数字――‘956kg，989kg，923kg，965kg……’。
“在去测试一下速度。”罗峰转头朝跑道走去，“只要我的速度过关，加上我的神经反应速度，之前就达标了。那么准武者考核，就一定能过！”
罗峰调整一下呼吸。
整个人仿佛一发炮弹猛然射出，沿着跑道迅速穿过。

高级学员教学楼四楼，正并肩走着的红发男子，以及黑衣光头中年人正谈笑走着。
“严罗，咱们多久没见了。”光头中年人微笑道，“快三年了吧，当初那个稚嫩小家伙，现如今也是大名鼎鼎了，我可是听说你这一次赚了近一个亿地球币吧，啧啧。看到你，我就觉得，我老喽。”
“运气好而已。”红发男子笑着道，“江哥，你当初……”
“滴，滴，滴！”
楼下传来的微弱声音，让这二人都惊讶相识一眼。
“楼下的拳力测试机，是最初等的拳力测试机，达到1000公斤，会发出这声音。”光头中年人惊讶道，“早上五点多，也有人来练拳，而且一拳能过一千公斤，难道是那个杨武？”
“去看看不就知道了？”
呼！呼！
一黑衣，一白衣，这二人化作两道幻影直接沿着楼梯，几乎一眨眼，就从四楼来到三楼练武厅门口。
黑衣光头中年人、白衣短发男子并肩看着练武厅内，此时的罗峰正站在跑道前，而后飞窜而过。
“28.1m/s。”黑衣光头中年人，白衣红发男子，都一眼看到速度测试仪屏幕上的显示数字。
“这个罗峰，拳力超过1000公斤，速度竟然达到一秒28.1米。”黑发光头中年人有些吃惊。
“江哥，这个小家伙年级不大吧，竟然达到武者身体素质要求了。”红发男子惊讶道，黑发光头中年人点头道：“嗯，他叫罗峰，是我们武馆这一批中比较有天赋的学员。今年也才刚刚十八周岁！”
“十八周岁？这么小？”红发男子不由眼睛一亮。
而这时候，发现门口二人的罗峰不由一惊，红发男子是之前开跑车过来的武者，而这黑衣光头中年人可是这所极限武馆的馆主‘江年’，权力最大的人物。按照极限武馆的规矩，学员都是称呼他为‘教官’的。
“教官！”罗峰连行礼喊道。
“过来。”教官江年笑着喊道，“没想到罗峰你竟然这么快，就达到武者素质要求了，我给你介绍一下，这位是你的前辈严罗，严罗，我将你的名字告诉他，没事吧？”
“没事。”严罗看着罗峰，点点头，“这小家伙，这么年轻就达到武者身体素质要求，或许将来，他也能跟我有所交集。”
江年看向罗峰，一笑道：“罗峰，你18周岁，应该是今年高考吧。别管今年考的怎么样了，上学又有什么用？你现在就安心准备‘武者实战考核’吧。哦，对了，7月1号这天，你去一趟扬州城的极限会馆，去那进行‘准武者考核’，以你现在实力，很容易过的。”
“高考？”旁边严罗一笑，“别去大学浪费时间了，你天赋不错，不管做什么事情都要全身心投入，你现在就要将全部精力放在武道之上。小子，等成了武者，加入咱们极限武馆，这才有前途。”

这两大武者，地位都极高，对社会上所谓的富豪、官员等，都是不屑一顾的。
而对于同样将跨入武者行列，而且岁数还很小的罗峰，他们却很是期待。
ps：第一章到！。
content_en:
"557 points, the undergraduate score is 561?" Luo Feng took a deep breath.
Just four points away! Just because of these four points, he would not have the chance to go to military school.
Twelve years of cultural education and study turned out to be this result.
"If you can't go to the military academy, you can't go to the military academy. What's the big deal." Luo Feng's eyes narrowed, and he raised his right hand to form a knife and cut it straight forward. The air suddenly trembled as the palm knife passed through at high speed, making a heart-shaking sound of applause. "This coma has improved my strength a lot!"
"Perhaps, my current physical fitness has reached that of a warrior. I can pass the 'Quasi Warrior Assessment'."
"Even if it's a little bit off, the difference is not big. If you work hard and practice hard for a month or two, you should be able to pass the 'quasi-martial artist examination'."
Luo Feng has a strong ability to adapt. This time, his college entrance examination results did not meet the undergraduate level, which was a big blow to him. However, the 'coma' caused his physical fitness to improve again, which also gave him confidence!
After all, the status of a military academy graduate is far inferior to that of a warrior!
"Click!" Luo Feng
In the living room, parents Luo Hongguo, Gong Xinlan, and younger brother Luo Hua all turned to look over, with concern in their eyes. Gong Xinlan stood up and walked towards Luo Feng: "Xiao Feng, I can't blame you for this college entrance examination. I only blame your headache. Alas, why did this disease happen now? It hasn't happened in several years."
"Brother, you won't be hit, will you?" His younger brother Luo Hua sat in a wheelchair and deliberately joked.
Luo Feng was checking his scores in the house before, and his parents and younger brother also checked the college entrance examination scores through his younger brother' Luo Hua's laptop, and found out that Luo Feng's college entrance examination scores were only four points short of the undergraduate level. Although they were a little disappointed, they were more worried about Luo Feng.
Luo Feng smiled: "Of course I won't hit you, parents, don't blame this headache. To be honest, you still need to thank this headache?"
"Thank you?"
"Thank you?"
"Thank you?"
Luo Hongguo, Gong Xinlan, and Luo Hua in the wheelchair were all stunned. The college entrance examination is a major event in life. Now that Luo Feng's college entrance examination has been ruined by this headache, why should he thank this headache?
"Mom and Dad, Ah Hua." Luo Feng said with a slight smile, "When I was a child, I had two headaches that made me faint. In fact, after waking up in those two times, I felt that my strength had increased a lot and I could run faster. This time... it is the same! I feel that my physical fitness is much better than before, and I will probably pass the 'quasi-martial artist examination'."
"What?" Luo Hongguo, Gong Xinlan, and Luo Hua looked at each other.
"Brother, is it true?" Luo Hua couldn't help but ask.
"Of course it's true." Luo Feng smiled slightly, "After passing the quasi-martial artist assessment, you can apply for the 'martial artist practical assessment'. I am very confident in my actual combat ability, and I may be able to become a warrior this year!"
Father Luo Hongguo, mother Gong Xinlan, and brother Luo Hua were all shocked by the news.
Warrior!
What does that mean? That represents a group of people with the most transcendent status among human beings, and represents privilege! Represents a lot of money! Represents a superior status! And once you become a warrior, the various benefits it brings to your family are much better than becoming an elite student in a military academy.
"A warrior is going to be born in our family?" His younger brother Luo Hua couldn't help shouting, "Haha, brother, I admire you."
"Xiao Feng, that's good." Luo Hongguo also patted Luo Feng's shoulder excitedly, "It's good to be a warrior. Compared with warriors, what does a military academy graduate mean?"
Nowadays, human society all over the world worships and respects warriors.
Seeing his parents and younger brother so happy, Luo Feng chuckled and said, "Mom and dad, we haven't passed the test yet, so we can't get too proud too early."
"An 18-year-old warrior?" Luo Hua couldn't help but scream excitedly, "What if my brother reallyBecoming an eighteen-year-old warrior, that, that is really, really... awesome! ! ! "
××××××
At five o'clock the next morning, it was dark.
Luo Feng left home and rushed to the extreme martial arts gym.
“There are really few people at this time. "After Luo Feng entered the extreme martial arts gym, he found that only about a hundred people could be seen on the grass and roads of the entire martial arts gym. You must know that there are as many as 30,000 to 40,000 students in the entire martial arts gym. "Every time the martial arts teacher teaches, he teaches at night. Night is when there are the most people in the martial arts gym. "
Walking on the road, Luo Feng rushed directly to the teaching building for senior students.
"Rumble~~" came the low sound of air waves.
"Eh? "
Luo Feng couldn't help but turn around and saw a very gorgeous white sports car slowly driving into the martial arts gym. Luo Feng couldn't help taking a closer look and took a breath: "Is it an Aston Martin sports car? Or the latest and most expensive thr-191 with flight functions? "
My younger brother likes sports cars very much. When he was at home, he and Luo Feng also praised this Thr-191.
"It's an Aston Martin. "
"It's 191, it has a flight function. "In the courtyard of the martial arts hall, students who were usually sparse in twos and threes were attracted one by one, "This car costs 36 million Chinese coins. "
At this moment, the sports car stopped at the entrance of the senior student teaching building. The car door was stained, and he glanced around casually, past the ordinary martial arts students, paused briefly on Luo Feng, and then entered the teaching building without saying anything.
“It’s a warrior. "Luo Feng's eyes lit up.
The look in the warrior's eyes just now made Luo Feng feel stressed. This was a look with an iron will after experiencing life and death battles again and again.
"I have never seen this warrior in the martial arts gym before? Why did he come to the martial arts school? "Luo Feng also entered the martial arts training hall on the third floor of the teaching building of the Advanced Academy.
The spacious martial arts training hall was empty, not a single person.
It's only around five o'clock in the morning. Even at night when there are the most people, there are usually no more than twenty people here, let alone early in the morning.
"I want to see how much strength I have reached now. "Luo Feng walked over, plugged in the plug of the boxing strength testing machine, and turned the switch on.
Stand in front of the boxing strength testing machine.
"Let's get started! "
Luo Feng took a deep breath, centering on his waist and hips, strong force was emitted through his waist, and then his spine suddenly arched, like a big python, generating a strong force that penetrated through his arms, and then Luo Feng's fist was like a bolt of lightning, and suddenly hit the boxing target with a "peng" sound.
“Bit, beep, beep! "The boxing strength testing machine made three consecutive beeps.
Luo Feng's eyes lit up. Normally, punching strength testing machines would not make such a sound. Making such a sound means that the punching force exceeds 1,000kg.
"Huh? "Luo Feng stared at the display screen of the punching strength testing machine - '1089kg'.
"So many? "
Luo Feng felt ecstatic in his heart. The physical requirement for a warrior is that his boxing power must reach 900kg. Before, his boxing power was 809kg, but now it has reached 1089kg, an increase of 280kg. Far beyond the qualifying line.
"Haha. "
Luo Feng's excited fists punched out like lightning, his whole body shaking from side to side, and the sound of "peng" and "peng" could be heard continuously. In almost the blink of an eye, Luo Feng had punched more than twenty times. The screen of the boxing strength testing machine also showed a series of numbers - '956kg, 989kg, 923kg, 965kg...'.
"Going to test the speed. Luo Feng turned and walked towards the track, "As long as my speed passes the standard, plus my nerve reaction speed, I have met the standard before." Then you will definitely pass the quasi-martial artist assessment! "
Luo Feng adjusted his breathing.
The whole person seemed to be shot out suddenly, along the runwayGo through quickly.
On the fourth floor of the senior student teaching building, a red-haired man and a bald middle-aged man in black were walking side by side, talking and laughing.
"Yan Luo, it's been a long time since we last met." The bald middle-aged man smiled and said, "It's been almost three years. The naive little guy back then is now famous. I heard that you made nearly 100 million earth coins this time. Tsk tsk. When I see you, I feel like I'm old."
"It's just good luck." The red-haired man said with a smile, "Brother Jiang, when you..."
"Dip, beep, beep!"
The faint sound coming from downstairs made the two people look at each other in surprise.
"The boxing strength testing machine downstairs is the most advanced boxing strength testing machine. When it reaches 1,000 kilograms, it will make this sound." The bald middle-aged man said in surprise, "At around five o'clock in the morning, there are people who come to practice boxing, and one punch can weigh over a thousand kilograms. Is it that Yang Wu?"
"You'll know if you go and see it?"
Phew! call!
One in black, the other in white, these two people turned into two phantoms and walked directly along the stairs. Almost in the blink of an eye, they came from the fourth floor to the entrance of the martial arts training hall on the third floor.
A bald middle-aged man in black and a short-haired man in white looked side by side into the martial arts training hall. At this time, Luo Feng was standing in front of the runway, and then flew past.
"28.1m/s." The bald middle-aged man in black and the red-haired man in white saw the numbers displayed on the speed tester screen at a glance.
"This Luo Feng, his punching power exceeds 1,000 kilograms, and his speed reaches 28.1 meters per second." The middle-aged man with black hair was a little surprised.
"Brother Jiang, this little guy is not very old, but he has actually met the physical requirements for a martial artist." The red-haired man was surprised, and the middle-aged man with black hair nodded: "Well, his name is Luo Feng, and he is one of the more talented students in our martial arts school. He has just turned eighteen this year!"
"Eighteen years old? So young?" The red-haired man couldn't help but his eyes lit up.
At this time, Luo Feng was shocked when he noticed the two people at the door. The red-haired man was the martial artist who drove the sports car before, and the bald middle-aged man in black was the owner of this extreme martial arts gym, 'Jiang Nian', the most powerful person. According to the rules of the Extreme Martial Arts School, students call him 'instructor'.
"Instructor!" Luo Feng saluted and shouted.
"Come here." Instructor Jiang Nian shouted with a smile, "I didn't expect you, Luo Feng, to meet the requirements of a warrior so quickly. Let me introduce to you. This is your senior Yan Luo. Yan Luo, I will tell him your name. Are you okay?"
"It's okay." Yan Luo looked at Luo Feng and nodded, "This little guy has met the physical requirements for a warrior at such a young age. Maybe he can interact with me in the future."
Jiang Nian looked at Luo Feng and said with a smile: "Luo Feng, you are 18 years old. You should be taking the college entrance examination this year. Don't worry about how you did in the exam this year. What's the point of going to school? You can just prepare for the 'actual combat assessment of warriors' now. Oh, by the way, on July 1st, you go to the Extreme Guild Hall in Yangzhou City to take the 'quasi-martial arts assessment'. With your current strength, you can pass it easily."
"College entrance exam?" Yan Luo smiled next to him, "Don't waste time going to college. You have great talent. No matter what you do, you must devote yourself to it. You must focus all your energy on martial arts now. Boy, wait until you become a martial artist and join our extreme martial arts gym. Only then will you have a future."
These two warriors have extremely high status, and they disdain the so-called rich people, officials, etc. in society.
But they were looking forward to Luo Feng, who was also about to join the ranks of warriors and was still very young.
